heading: Is Rice-vermicelli gluten free?
intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Rice-vermicelli and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Rice vermicelli is typically made from rice flour and is generally gluten-free; however, cross-contamination during processing or preparation can pose a risk for those with coeliac disease. It's important to ensure that no gluten-containing ingredients are used in the dish or during cooking.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.body: Rice-vermicelli can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.

faq.question: What should I ask a restaurant?
faq.answer: Ask about shared equipment, sauces, marinades, and whether the kitchen has a dedicated gluten-free prep area.
